title: The Pawns Already Did the Work
setup: Black's own pawns on f7, g7 and h7 have the king boxed in, but Black's rook on e5 and bishop on d2 are active.
hint: The mate is one check away. Identify the square Black is forced to fill and who is left to take it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} is met only by {{Re8}}, since the pawns have taken every flight square themselves. {{Qxe8#}} finishes. The shelter the king built is the cage it dies in.
